risks.title: Geopolitical conflicts and global instability
risks.score_rationale: Risk ranks at top of 1A, mentions major conflicts (Russia-Ukraine, Middle East, Latin America) with strong language on material and unpredictable impact. Geopolitical category highly weighted here. Risk stable versus prior year.

risks.title: Volatility in oil and gas prices
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned as key factor affecting demand and revenues. Direct language on volatility and its impact on results. Major macroeconomic repercussions. Central position in 10-K. Stable versus N-1.

risks.title: Cyberattacks and digital security
risks.score_rationale: Text emphasizes increased vulnerability due to digitalization and geopolitical conflicts. Mention of rising incident rates. Implicit upward risk trajectory. Cybersecurity category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Regulatory and environmental compliance
risks.score_rationale: Risk covers critical areas: environmental, tax, ESG, and climate legislation. Insistent language on growing complexity. Mention of global initiatives. High weighting for Regulation category.

risks.title: Supply shortages and delivery delays
risks.score_rationale: Text cites shortages, delays and price increases related to macro conditions and geopolitical factors. Direct impact on costs and profitability. Explicit mention of tariffs and trade policies. Industrial category heavily affected.

risks.title: Technology innovation challenges
risks.score_rationale: Risk formulated as ability to adapt to technological evolution and energy transition. Mention of artificial intelligence and digitalization. Concerned language on competitiveness. Technology category under pressure.

risks.title: Non-current asset impairment
risks.score_rationale: Amount at stake is high ($1.5 billion in assets). External auditor (KPMG) highlights this as critical audit matter. Risk of significant non-cash charges. Capital category sensitive.

ai_positioning.summary: WFRD does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning as initiatives or strategic positioning in its 2025 annual report. Only indirect mention in the context of future technology challenges.
